solutionContexts.label: Cesium-oleate stock · preparation components
solutionContexts.scope: Whole-stock preparation uses 1.25 mmol Cs2CO3, 1.25 mL oleic acid and 20 mL ODE. Only 0.4 mL stock is injected into the NC synthesis. The stock is reported as 0.117 mol/L. Carbonate is a starting reagent, not a claim of unchanged carbonate in the prepared stock. ODE positional identity, final measured stock volume, storage and solution speciation are unreported.
